top_classes.name: Light yellowish brown interior dry gravelly loam
Dark brown interior moist clay loam
8 km north of Deir El zor, Syria via USDA Soil Conservationservice.
Mrayia Dair El zor, Syria via USDA Soil Conservation service.
San Bernadino Co., Ca.,China Lake via USDA Soil Conservationservice.
Settat, Morocco, 7 km N of Settat on Casablanca highway, 30 m east offield Rd near cemetary via USDA Soil Conserviation service.

The parent material is alluvium from mixed material, alluvial fine material overlayed on gypsum sandy loam, uncultivated from terracettes in lake plains. Light yellowish brown interior dry gravelly loam. Original ASTER Spectral Library name was jhu.becknic.soil.aridisol.calciorthid.coarse.79P1536.spectrum.txt

The parent material is alluvium from terracettes in lake plains, nonreclaimed salt-affected soil, barren land runoff. Dark brown interior moist clay loam, surface crust of 0.5 cm formed by salt deposition in microdepressions (fine-loamy, mixed, thermic typic salorthid). Original ASTER Spectral Library name was jhu.becknic.soil.aridisol.salorthid.coarse.79P1530.spectrum.txt

Parent material: alluvium over lacustrine material. Physiography: playa. Dark yellowish brown silty clay (Clayey over loamy, mixed thermic Typic Salorthid). Original ASTER Spectral Library name was jhu.becknic.soil.aridisol.salorthid.coarse.89P1805.spectrum.txt

Parent material: unconsolidated sediments from mixed-calcareous material, cropland. Physiography: backslope crested hills. Brown to dark brown clay (fine, montmorillonitic, thermic palexerollic chromoxerert). Original ASTER Spectral Library name was jhu.becknic.soil.vertisol.chromoxerert.coarse.88P475.spectrum.txt
